item.title: Alberta Says No to MAGA-Aligned Independence Campaign
item.description:
Alberta resoundingly voted against a path to independence in a referendum on Monday, in a blow to the right-wing campaign to separate the wealthy western province from Canada. Albertan independence had drawn support from MAGA-influenced movements and Christian nationalists on both sides of the border , but faced an especially uphill battle in the face of President Donald Trump’s threats to invade and subjugate Canada. The province’s leader, Danielle Smith, who came to power with the backing of separatists, added the question to provincial ballots in May after a petition for independence collected over 200,000 verified signatures. She tentatively supported a no vote, but federal leaders from across the political spectrum including Prime Minister Mark Carney rallied to defend a united Canada. item.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
item.description:
Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in a phone call Tuesday that President Trump hasn't issued any kind of order to harm Ukraine. Why it matters: The call was an effort to prevent the crisis between the U.S. and Ukraine from escalating further — and to push back on Ukrainian accusations that Trump is trying to coerce Zelensky into making concessions to Russia. The 45-minute call took place several hours ahead of a new round of peace talks with White House envoy Steve Witkoff aimed at reaching a unified position with European allies on an updated peace proposal to present to Russian President Vladimir Putin. item.title: The case that could weaken one of Texas’ most ambitious anti-abortion laws
item.description:
When Texas lawmakers enacted House Bill 7 — a sweeping law that allows private citizens to sue anyone who helps distribute abortion medication in the state — Students for Life cheered the measure. Now, that anti-abortion group is being sued under the law they championed, in a case that experts say could ultimately weaken the very tool organizations hoped would stop people from getting abortions in Texas. Abortion opponents are also planning to file their own lawsuits that could also define HB 7. “The genius of the suit is that it shows if HB 7 is as broad as it seems, it can be used against anyone, including people who share a judge’s perspective on abortion,” said Mary Ziegler, a law professor at the University of California, Davis. “It’s obviously precedent-setting.” The suit targets four people associated with Students for Life for allegedly ordering abortion medications into Texas…

item.title: ‘Bad decisions’: Man convicted for taking Peachy the flamingo from Las Vegas hotel
item.description:
CBS A Canadian tourist who stole a flamingo from a Las Vegas hotel casino after a marathon drinking session has been convicted of animal abuse and faces nearly five years in prison. Mitchell Fairbarn, 34, took the Chilean flamingo, Peachy, from the Flamingo Las Vegas wildlife habitat in March and carried the bird to his hotel room by its neck. Footage shown at trial captured him smiling as he transported the animal in an elevator. Fairbarn testified he had consumed 30 to 40 beers and thought taking the bird would be “funny”. His lawyer, Josh Tomsheck, argued the incident was a misguided prank fuelled by alcohol, admitting Fairbarn had made “bad decisions”. Animal experts told the court Peachy suffered torn feathers and blood loss. A state veterinarian said the bird has largely recovered but is now more anxious around people. item.title: France: Local curfews imposed after protests
item.description:
France’s Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez on Monday admitted that police “lost control” in some cities over the weekend as violent protests erupted across the country, while French President Emmanuel Macron called for a review of the police response to the rioting and looting. Nuñez said there had been a "lack of anticipation" ahead of the demonstrations on Saturday and acknowledged that policing numbers had fallen short in some areas as hundreds of thousands took to the streets to protest over, what they say are, underfunded public services and rising cost-of-living pressures. The demonstrations followed weeks of ‌student protests that had also seen some violence. In the wake of the chaotic scenes, Nuñez offered his resignation to Macron because he "felt responsible” for how things unfolded. item.title: US bans use of China’s DeepSeek AI tools by government agencies
item.description:
The US banned Chinese AI firm DeepSeek from most government systems and asked agencies to remove all technology built with it, as competition for AI supremacy between the superpowers heats up. US firms have long accused Chinese rivals of “distilling” their AI models, in what the White House’s technology advisor has called a “ malicious exploitation ” of American technology. While skepticism about the impact of AI has grown on both sides of the Pacific, researchers say Washington and Beijing should look past differences and work together to rein in the powerful technology, which some warn poses an existential threat to humanity. “ A narrow bilateral framework is needed now, ” a Silicon Valley investor wrote in The Washington Post. — Jeronimo Gonzalez

item.title: Texas data center boom could erase decades of progress on air quality
item.description:
A group of Texans believe they’ve discovered evidence that the state’s environmental regulatory agency has continued to issue permits to data centers despite Governor Greg Abbott’s call for it to stop. The nonprofits Public Citizen and FracTracker Alliance, working with local activists in Texas, looked through the public database of the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) and discovered that the organization has worked on multiple permits for data center projects since Abbott called for a pause in the process on September 21. Abbott’s office denied approving any new permits in a statement to 404 Media. According to Public Citizen and the FracTracker Alliance, which cite documents publicly available on the TCEQ’s website, the agency has reviewed documents and assigned engineers related to more than a dozen permits related to data center projects in the state. I am a simple person—I see a video from Northernlion comparing a game to Balatro and I click the link. This is the path that brought me to Combolands , a roguelike city builder that is currently haunting my every waking moment. Combolands is a lot like Balatro , to be fair, and that’s what sets it apart from other city builders. These cards give you base points from their descriptions, but can also be combined with other cards near to them to give them multipliers. A Farmyard card will generate manure on an empty space near it.
